title: PIR benchmark result record
description: One measurement of one PIR implementation at one parameter point. This is the single source of truth consumed by the site.

implementation.description: Which concrete codebase produced this record.

forked_from.description: Upstream this implementation descends from. Omit for independent implementations; drives the lineage column on the site.

backend.description: Acceleration this build actually used, e.g. ['avx512f','blas'] or ['avx2','rayon']. Two rows with different backends are not the same measurement.

params.description: The benchmark configuration. Rows are only comparable when these match.

record_bytes.description: Size of one record in bytes.

scheme_params.description: Scheme-specific tuning (poly degree, moduli, packing params, ...).

environment.description: Where it ran. Two rows with different environments are not directly comparable.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC time the run completed.

metrics.description: Measured quantities. All optional so partial runs are still valid; omit what was not measured rather than reporting 0.

offline_hint_bytes.description: One-time offline download (hint/params), 0 for silent-preprocessing schemes.

server_throughput_mbps.description: Online throughput: database bytes / server_answer_ms, in MB/s. Present ONLY for implementations whose online answer scans the whole database (props.json online_scans_full_db). Omitted for silent-preprocessing schemes, where the online phase touches preprocessed state and this ratio would exceed DRAM bandwidth.

preprocessing_throughput_mbps.description: Offline throughput: database bytes / preprocessing_ms, in MB/s. Well-defined for every implementation, since the offline phase touches the whole database once.

metrics_spread.description: Observed variation for the metrics above, where the implementation exposed it. Keyed by the same metric names. Kept separate so the headline values in `metrics` stay scalar.

n.description: How many independent measurements the spread is over.

notes.description: Free-form caveats, e.g. 'single-threaded only', 'estimated from paper Table 3'.
